paragraphs.en: There are various reasons why people {compose} poetry. Some poems tell a story or describe a certain image in the reader's mind. Others try to convey certain feelings such as joy and {sorrow}. The distinctive characteristics of poetry often include economical use of words, descriptive and vivid language, integrated {imagery}, {literary} devices such as similes and metaphors, and arrangement of words, lines, rhymes, and {rhythm}. Poets use many different forms of poetry to express themselves. Now we will look at a few of the simpler forms.
paragraphs.cn: 人们写诗有着各种各样的理由。有些诗讲述一个故事，或者描绘读者心目中的某个意象。另一些诗则试图传达某种感情，比如喜悦和悲伤。诗歌的独特特征通常包括：用词简练、语言生动形象、意象整合、运用明喻和暗喻等文学手法，以及字词、诗行、韵脚和节奏的编排。诗人用许多不同的诗歌形式来表达自己。现在我们来看看几种比较简单的形式。

paragraphs.en: Some of the first poems a young child learns in English are {nursery} rhymes. They are usually the traditional poems or {folk} songs. The language of these rhymes, like Poem A, is to the point but has a storyline. Many children enjoy {nursery} rhymes because they {rhyme}, have a strong {rhythm}, and often repeat the same words. The poems may not make sense and even seem {contradictory}, but they are easy to learn and {recite}. By playing with the words in {nursery} rhymes, children learn about language.
paragraphs.cn: 幼儿最早学的一些英文诗是童谣。它们通常是传统的诗歌或民歌。这些童谣的语言，如诗歌A，简洁中肯但具有故事性。许多孩子喜欢童谣，因为童谣押韵、节奏感强，并且经常重复相同的词语。这些诗歌可能讲不通，甚至看起来自相矛盾，但是它们容易学也容易背诵。通过童谣中的文字游戏，孩子们学到了语言。

paragraphs.en: Hush, little baby, don't say a word, Papa's going to buy you a {mockingbird}. If that {mockingbird} won't sing, Papa's going to buy you a {diamond} ring. If that {diamond} ring turns to {brass}, Papa's going to buy you a looking-glass. If that looking-glass gets broke, Papa's going to buy you a billy goat. If that billy goat runs away, Papa's going to buy you another today.
paragraphs.cn: 小宝宝，别说话， 爸爸给你买个小嘲鸟。 小嘲鸟不会唱， 爸爸给你买个钻石戒。 钻石戒变了铜， 爸爸给你买个小镜子。 小镜子打破了， 爸爸给你买只公山羊。 公山羊跑掉了， 爸爸今天再给你买一只。

paragraphs.en: One of the simplest kinds of poem is the "list poem", which contains a list of things, people, ideas, or descriptions that develop a particular theme. List poems have a flexible line length and repeated phrases which give both a pattern and a {rhythm} to the poem. Some {rhyme} (like B and C), while others do not.
paragraphs.cn: 最简单的一种诗歌是"清单诗"，它包含一系列事物、人物、想法或描述，这些内容围绕一个特定主题展开。清单诗的诗行长度灵活，有重复的短语，使诗歌既有一定的模式又有节奏感。有些清单诗押韵（如诗歌B和诗歌C），有些则不押韵。

paragraphs.en: I saw a fish-pond all on fire, I saw a house bow to a squire, I saw a person twelve-feet high, I saw a cottage in the sky, I saw a balloon made of lead, I saw a coffin drop down dead, I saw two sparrows run a race, I saw two horses making lace, I saw a girl just like a cat, I saw a kitten wear a hat, I saw a man who saw these too, And said though strange they all were true.
paragraphs.cn: 我看到鱼塘在燃烧， 我看到房子向地主鞠躬， 我看到一个十二英尺高的人， 我看到天空中有小屋， 我看到一个铅做的气球， 我看到棺材突然倒下死去， 我看到两只麻雀赛跑， 我看到两匹马做蕾丝， 我看到一个像猫一样的女孩， 我看到一只小猫戴帽子， 我看到一个人也看到了这些， 他说尽管奇怪但都是真的。

paragraphs.en: Our first football match We would have won ... if Jack had scored that goal, if we'd had just a few more minutes, if we had trained harder, if Ben had passed the ball to Joe, if we'd had thousands of fans screaming, if I hadn't taken my eye off the ball, if we hadn't stayed up so late the night before, if we hadn't taken it easy, if we hadn't run out of energy. We would have won ... if we'd been better!
paragraphs.cn: 我们的第一场足球赛 我们本来会赢的…… 如果杰克踢进了那个球， 如果我们再多几分钟， 如果我们训练得更刻苦， 如果本把球传给了乔， 如果我们有成千上万的球迷呐喊， 如果我没有把目光从球上移开， 如果我们头天晚上没有熬夜， 如果我们没有放松警惕， 如果我们没有精疲力竭。 我们本来会赢的…… 如果我们能表现得更好！

paragraphs.en: Another simple form of poem that amateurs can easily write is the {cinquain}, which is made up of five lines. With these, you can convey a strong picture or a certain {mood} in just a few words. Look at the example (D).
paragraphs.cn: 另一种业余爱好者容易写的简体诗是五行诗，由五行组成。用五行诗，只需寥寥数语就能传达出一幅生动的画面或某种心情。请看示例（D）。

paragraphs.en: Brother Beautiful, athletic Teasing, shouting, laughing Friend and enemy too Mine
paragraphs.cn: 兄弟 美丽，健壮 逗弄，叫喊，欢笑 朋友也是敌人 我的

paragraphs.en: {Haiku} is a Japanese form of poetry that consists of 17 syllables. It has a {format} of three lines, containing 5, 7, and 5 syllables {respectively}. It is not a traditional form of English poetry, but is very popular with English writers. It is easy to write and, like the {cinquain}, can give a clear picture and create a special feeling using very few words. The {haiku} poem (E) on the right is a translation from Japanese, which shows a moment in the life of a {delicate} {butterfly}.
paragraphs.cn: 俳句是一种日本诗歌形式，由17个音节组成。它的格式为三行，分别包含5、7和5个音节。它不是传统的英语诗歌形式，但深受英语作家的欢迎。它容易写，而且像五行诗一样，能用极少的文字呈现清晰的画面、营造特殊的感受。右边这首俳句诗（E）是从日语翻译而来的，展现了一只纤弱的蝴蝶生命中的一刻。

paragraphs.en: A fallen {blossom} Is coming back to the branch. Look, a {butterfly}!
paragraphs.cn: 落花 正在回到枝头。 看，一只蝴蝶！

paragraphs.en: English speakers also enjoy poems from China, those from the Tang Dynasty in particular. A lot of Tang poetry has been translated into English, such as this one (F).
paragraphs.cn: 说英语的人也喜欢中国的诗歌，尤其是唐诗。许多唐诗已经被翻译成英语，如这首（F）。

paragraphs.en: With so many different forms of poetry to choose from, you may {eventually} want to write poems of your own. Give it a try!
paragraphs.cn: 有这么多可供选择的诗歌形式，你也许最终想自己写诗了。试一试吧！

paragraphs.en: Where she awaits her husband On and on the river flows. Never looking back, Transformed into stone. Day by day upon the mountain top, wind and rain {revolve}. Should the journeyer return, this stone would {utter} speech. (by Wang Jian)
paragraphs.cn: 望夫处，江悠悠。 化为石，不回头。 山头日日风复雨， 行人归来石应语。 （王建）
